How to read this sheet. A firm can only grow in the long run if it reinvests, and each rupiah reinvested earns ROIC. A high fundamental g (di atas the cap) means the Proyeksi reinvests heavily at a high return, which cannot continue forever, so the cap applies. For loss-making firms such as ABBA, NOPAT is Negatif, ROIC and the reinvestment rate are not meaningful, and g must be a reasoned judgement (0% to 3% is a defensible range when net reinvestment is close to zero).

COST STRUCTURE, SEGMENT CONCENTRATION & Skenario Dasar (Base Case) NARRATIVE (MILESTONE 4)
Variable Costs
Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) is variable and scales with Pendapatan (41.1% in Base). It includes payment processing, driver and merchant transaction costs, and cloud hosting directly tied to orders.
Semi Variable Costs
Sales & Marketing and Product Development are semi variable. Promo spending moves with user activity, while engineering and brand costs are set by management budget.
Fixed Costs

General & Administrative (office salaries, legal, and rent), Operational Support, Depreciation & Amortization, and Utang Interest are mostly fixed. In 2025, Total Beban Operasional rose only 2.2% (from Rp 10,722 bn to Rp 10,954 bn) even though Pendapatan grew 15.3%. Holding fixed operating costs constant at 2025 levels (Rp 10,954 bn) instead of scaling them at the 78.5% three Tahun Rata-Rata lets GoTo reach breakeven at Rp 18,599 bn of Pendapatan and achieve Positif EBIT of Rp 1,066 bn in 2026F.
Segment Concentration

GoTo's Pendapatan Pertumbuhan is concentrated in two core segments rather than spread evenly across all segments. In 2025, Financial Technology (GoPay payments and consumer loans) grew 74.1% and contributed 91.0% of GoTo's Total Pendapatan increase, while On Demand Services (Gojek rides and delivery) grew 13.8% and contributed 61.8% of the increase.
Skenario Dasar (Base Case) Narrative (194 words)

We chose the Skenario Dasar (Base Case) anchored on GoTo's 2023 to 2025 historical averages (11.4% Pendapatan Pertumbuhan and 41.1% COGS as a percentage of Pendapatan) because it balances GoTo's slower 2024 transition Tahun after Tokopedia (7.5% Pertumbuhan) with its stronger 2025 Pertumbuhan (15.3% Pertumbuhan). The Optimis scenario (15.3% Pertumbuhan, 38.1% COGS, and 55.7% Beban Operasional) assumes fast GoPay loan Pertumbuhan continues without interruption, while the Konservatif scenario (7.5% Pertumbuhan, 46.6% COGS, and 85.0% Beban Operasional) assumes slower demand and heavier promo competition. How we treat fixed versus variable costs strongly shapes the Proyeksi result. When Beban Operasional are scaled with Pendapatan at the three Tahun Rata-Rata of 78.5% (pushed up by 2023 expenses of 117.0%), Beban Operasional are higher than Marjin Kotor (58.9%), leaving GoTo di bawah breakeven in all three Proyeksi Tahun. However, our Minggu 12 cost structure analysis showed that GoTo's Beban Operasional are mostly fixed: Total Beban Operasional stayed almost flat at Rp 10,954 billion in 2025 (up only 2.2%) while Pendapatan grew 15.3%. When fixed Beban Operasional are not scaled with Pendapatan, Laba Kotor rapidly covers fixed costs, pushing GoTo di atas its Rp 18,599 billion breakeven point in 2026F.
